title: Step 1: Read One Line
story: You will build a real tool: a log analyzer. Each step adds one piece, and your code carries over to the next step.
goal: Write parse_line(line) returning a dict with time, level and msg.
hints: Split the line on spaces, but only the first three, so the message stays whole.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
